autoResolveBuilds.title: Run Maven/Gradle when the IDE hasn't resolved dependencies
autoResolveBuilds.description: After each scan, Maven/Gradle versions come from the IDE's last Maven reload or Dependency Analyzer. When it has none, this runs mvn or gradle in the project, asking once per project first.
